units.topic: Boshlang'ich Grammatika (To Be va Present Simple)

theory.title: Boshlang'ich Grammatika (To Be va Present Simple)
theory.summary: Ingliz tili poydevori: Shaxs olmoshlari, to be fe'li (am, is, are) va doimiy takrorlanuvchi harakatlar zamoni (Present Simple).
rules: To Be (am, is, are): I am, He/She/It is, We/You/They are shakllari orqali kasb, holat va yosh ifodalanadi.
Present Simple qoidasi: Uchinchi shaxs birlikda (he/she/it) fe'l oxiriga -s yoki -es qo'shiladi (He studies, She speaks).
Savol va inkor: Do/Does yordamchi fe'llari ishlatiladi (Do you speak English? / She does not work).
Imlo qoidasi: Ingliz tilida 'I' (men) har doim katta harf bilan yoziladi.

vocabulary.example: Daily reading helps improve your vocabulary.

tips: Speaking 1-qismida qisqa emas, to'liq gaplar bilan javob berishga odatlaning (masalan, 'Yes, I am a university student').
Har doim to be va oddiy fe'lni birga ishlatishdan saqlaning (NOT: 'I am study', BUT: 'I study').
Har kuni kamida 15 daqiqa baland ovozda o'qish talaffuzni sezilarli yaxshilaydi.

theory.title: Elementary: O'tgan Zamon (Past Simple) va Sifatlar
theory.summary: O'tmishdagi voqea-hodisalarni tasvirlash, to'g'ri va noto'g'ri fe'llar, joy va vaqt predloglari (in, on, at).
rules: Past Simple: O'tgan zamonda to'g'ri fe'llarga -ed qo'shiladi (visited, played), noto'g'ri fe'llar esa 2-shaklga o'zgaradi (went, took, saw).
Inkor va so'roq: 'did' va 'did not' bilan fe'l o'zining asosiy shakliga qaytadi (Did you go? / I did not see).
Predloglar: Vaqtda soat oldidan 'at', kunlar oldidan 'on', oylar va yillar oldidan 'in' ishlatiladi.

vocabulary.example: He achieved a band 7.0 in his test.
They prepared thoroughly for the exam.

tips: IELTS Speaking Part 2 da bolalik yoki o'tgan voqealarni aytib berishda faqat Past Simple zamonidan to'g'ri foydalaning.
Noto'g'ri fe'llar jadvalini yodlashda ularni gaplar ichida ishlatib mashq qiling.

theory.title: Intermediate: Academic Education & Vocabulary
theory.summary: IELTS Writing Task 1 & 2 va Speaking uchun zarur bo'lgan akademik so'zlar, bog'lovchilar va murakkab gaplar.
rules: Complex sentences: Although, whereas, because kabi bog'lovchilar orqali murakkab gaplar tuzing.
Modal fe'llar: ehtimollik va tavsiyalarda might, should, could fe'llaridan unumli foydalaning.
Akademik til: Norasmiy so'zlar (gonna, stuff, kids) o'rniga akademik ekvivalentlarni ishlating (children, aspects).

vocabulary.example: Education plays a crucial role in society.

tips: Writing Task 2 da har bir fikringizni misollar bilan mustahkamlang.
Bir xil so'zlarni takrorlamaslik uchun sinonimlardan foydalaning.
